description.narrative: The most significant expected project-level outcome is increased access to climate finance (through green buildings and green affordable and women housing finance) in South Africa. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that its updated systematic engagement at both the sectoral and financial institutions levels, through investments, upstream, and AS, will help scale up climate finance and strengthen green finance standards in the country and encourage replication by other institutions, thus, contributing towards increased environmental sustainability through the demonstration and capacity building channels.

The proposed investment is a US$250 million senior unsecured loan, with a 7-year tenor (bullet), to Standard Bank of South Africa Limited (SBSA or the Bank) to support the growth of SBSAs EDGE-certified (or equivalent green certification acceptable to IFC) green building finance and green home loan portfolios in South Africa. Beneficiaries of the IFC loan are expected to benefit from performance-based incentives (PBI) to be provided by the UK Market Accelerator for Green Constructions (MAGC) Program (the Project).
